player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee dhieu Minesweeper.
Yadhieu ee këër ee rot looi yëp tɛ̈ɛ̈c wei dɛ̈ɛ̈r kek yëp.
Bëë yëp lac gɔ̈ɔ̈r, këër yëp lac wei yëp rot looi ee tɛ̈ɛ̈c wei dɛ̈ɛ̈r kek:
- `[row col]`: Yëp lac wei yëp rot looi ee tɛ̈ɛ̈c wei.
Tɛ̈ɛ̈c kënë:
- `[3 2]` yëp lac wei yëp rot looi ee tɛ̈ɛ̈c wei dhiëc 3, dɛ̈ɛ̈r 2.
- `[5 6]` yëp lac wei yëp rot looi ee tɛ̈ɛ̈c wei dhiëc 5, dɛ̈ɛ̈r 6.
Këër yëp lac gɔ̈ɔ̈r dhieu, yëp lac wei yëp rot looi ee tɛ̈ɛ̈c wei dɛ̈ɛ̈r kek yëp ee rot looi dɛ̈ɛ̈r.
Yëp lac wei yëp rot looi ee tɛ̈ɛ̈c wei ee tɔ̈:
. Këër ee rot looi yëp ee dɛ̈ɛ̈r kek yëp ee tɛ̈ɛ̈c wei.
Tɛ̈ɛ̈c ee rot looi yëp ee dɛ̈ɛ̈r kek yëp ee tɛ̈ɛ̈c wei:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Yïn akëc bɛ̈n bɛɛr në wël ke yïc ye kek nyuɔɔth.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Kä cï kek lueel në thööŋ de kuɛt yiic, aye ke kɔ̈ɔ̈c.
invalid_move.hit_mine: Yen aci dɔ̈ɔ̈r ku thak at ({row}, {col}).

game_action.revealed: Yen aci kekic ku bɛ̈i alɔŋ at ({row}, {col}).

outcome.win: Yïn amit puɔ̈u! yïn acï kä cï kek looi në luɔi de Minesweeper bɛ̈n nyaai.
outcome.turn_limit: Ye kë cï rot looi ë yic. yïn acï kä cë röt waar yök {percent}% në akuɔ̈tnhïïm ke kɔc tɔ̈u thïn yiic.
